title: p0031
universal_lens: Behavior constitutes a molar operator B: S × G → Π mapping situation-goal pairs to selected commerce patterns Π, where purpose P = ∇_π J(π) is the immanent gradient of the objective functional J over pattern space, and cognition C = ∂B/∂s encodes the observer-invariant sensitivity of the behavioral manifold to situational parameters.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats purpose P as a Bayesian prior over policy space Π with likelihood L(π|s,g) ∝ exp(−β‖π − π*(s,g)‖²), where the observer-invariant characters define a conformal predictor set C_α(s,g) = {π: p(π|s,g) ≥ α} guaranteeing marginal coverage over behavioral episodes.
gse_mapping: GSE instantiates the molar operator as a state-transition kernel T(s'|s,a) where a ∈ Π is the selected commerce pattern; purpose P(s,g) = V^π*(s) − V^π*(s₀) defines the value differential driving policy selection, with breakdown at singularity where ∇_s P = 0 (no goal gradient).

primitives.name: Molar Behavior Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: as a getting to such and such by means of such and such a selected pattern
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S: situation space (dimensionless manifold); G: goal space (dimensionless manifold); Π: pattern space of commerces-with (dimensionless); J: objective functional (dimensionless); B: molar behavior operator (dimensionless mapping)
primitives.assumptions: Behavior is molar (not molecular); patterns are selected from a repertoire; goals are identifiable end-states; observer-independent objectivity of characters
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no pattern achieves the goal (Π = ∅) or when multiple patterns yield identical J (degeneracy); molecular reflexes dominate (non-molar regime)

layer2.mapping: B ≡ policy π_θ in GSE; J ≡ value function V^π; Π ≡ action space A; S×G ≡ state-goal conditioning in goal-conditioned RL
layer2.telemetry: Pattern selection entropy H(π|s,g); goal achievement rate; molar vs molecular decomposition variance

primitives.latex: P(s,g) = \nabla_{\pi} \mathcal{J}(\pi; s, g) \big|_{\pi = B(s,g)}, \quad \text{where } \mathcal{J}(\pi) = \mathbb{E}[R(\tau) | \pi, s, g]
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P: purpose vector (dimensionless gradient in pattern space); J: objective functional (expected return, dimensionless); π: behavior pattern (dimensionless); ∇_π: functional derivative w.r.t pattern; R: reward signal (dimensionless); τ: trajectory
primitives.assumptions: Purpose is not mentalistic but an objective dynamic character immanent in behavior; defined by observable facts of the behavioral stream; determinant of pattern selection
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ∇_π J = 0 (flat landscape); when behavior is random (no gradient); when observer cannot identify goal g (epistemic breakdown)

layer2.mapping: P ≡ advantage function A^π(s,a) = Q^π(s,a) − V^π(s) in GSE; purpose gradient drives policy improvement via ∇_θ J(θ) = 𝔼[∇_θ log π_θ(a|s) A^π(s,a)]; in GSI, P defines the conformal score function
layer2.telemetry: Advantage estimation error; policy gradient norm; conformal prediction set size vs purpose magnitude

primitives.verbatim_quote: cat's purpose of getuing to the outside, by bursting through the confinement of the box, is
primitives.latex: s_{t+1} = f(s_t, \pi_t), \quad \pi_t = B(s_t, g_{\text{outside}}), \quad g_{\text{outside}} = \{s: \text{door open}\}, \quad P_t = \nabla_{\pi} \mathcal{J}(\pi_t)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: s_t: cat state in box (position, orientation, arousal; dimensionless); f: environment dynamics (dimensionless); π_t: selected escape pattern (squeeze, claw, bite, push; dimensionless); g_outside: goal state (door open; dimensionless); P_t: purpose gradient at time t (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Cat's behavior is molar and purposive; escape patterns form a finite repertoire; confinement defines the situation; outside is identifiable goal; learning modifies B over trials
primitives.breakdown_regime: When cat is exhausted (no pattern executed); when box is inescapable (Π = ∅); when cat freezes (molecular fear response dominates molar purpose)

layer2.mapping: Direct instantiation of molar operator in GSE: state s_t, goal g, pattern π_t = π_θ(s_t,g); purpose P_t = A^π(s_t,π_t); learning updates θ via policy gradient; GSI: conformal prediction of escape pattern given s_t
layer2.telemetry: Escape latency across trials; pattern diversity index; advantage function convergence; conformal prediction interval width

The source text (Tolman's molar behaviorism) establishes behavior as a mapping from situation-goal pairs to selected patterns of 'commerces-with' — a structural operator B: S×G→Π. Purpose is not mentalistic but the immanent dynamic character ∇_πJ defining the gradient of the objective functional over pattern space. Cognition enters as the observer-invariant sensitivity ∂B/∂s. The Thorndike cat illustrates: situation = confined in box, goal = outside, patterns = {squeeze, claw, bite, push}, purpose = gradient toward door-opening patterns. Observer invariance (ϕ_o1=ϕ_o2) makes characters objective. Breakdown occurs when Π=∅ (inescapable), ∇_πJ=0 (no gradient), or molecular responses dominate. This maps isomorphically to goal-conditioned RL: B≡π_θ, J≡V^π, P≡A^π, Φ≡sufficient statistic for policy equivalence. GSI conformal prediction uses Φ to construct observer-invariant prediction sets C_α. GSE state-transition kernel T(s'|s,a) with a∈Π implements the molar operator. The duality: purpose as both gradient (local) and value differential (global). Failure modes: epistemic (goal misidentification), structural (degenerate Π), dynamical (molecular override).
